title: Fix the current uncommitted issue #209 integration diff in this task branch after OneCPI review. ...
objective:
Fix the current uncommitted issue #209 integration diff in this task branch after OneCPI review. Confirmed HIGH: production refresh_search_roots_after_graph currently calls apply_workspace_roots_transition under SharedSearchEngine mutex, and apply performs a second full SourceSet scan + fs::read/hash for every file, blocking searches. Redesign core API so the expensive second validation happens off the outer MCP engine mutex (e.g. a public revalidate/validated-plan phase), while guarded apply under mutex does only in-memory epoch/cache checks + SQLite/cache/vector atomic mutation. Preserve core standalone safe API if needed, but production must use validated apply. Document watcher-backed race semantics: hub is rearmed before hook; any create/modify/delete after off-lock validation is queued and, after apply, attributed via new roots. Add a deterministic test proving filesystem scan/read validation does not execute while the outer engine mutex is held (use a test seam/barrier/counter, no sleeps).

Also address related review findings correctly: unchanged-root provider replacement must fence old overlay plans; do not silently swap provider. Avoid infinite expensive retry semantics beyond the existing 30s obligation—on incomplete scan keep last-known-good and retry, but do not add busy loops. Preserve pending embedding signals even if provider installation fails after an Applied transition. Critically inspect current replace_published_graph_context_provider design: stable overlay entries need not be discarded lexically, but stale semantic plans must be fenced and future point refreshes must use new provider. Add focused tests.

Run cargo fmt, cargo test -p bsl-search, targeted/full cargo test -p mcp-server, and clippy -D warnings as practical. Leave diff uncommitted for OneCPI rerun. Do not use wt/worktree or nested agents.
